answer: Neighborhood gale routing: each agent must maintain a live neighbor set whose churn stays below a threshold; a sudden gale of new peers flags the node. Enforcement compares a node's local lagoon of stable links against its total, requiring a minimum retention ratio over rolling windows. An attacker cloning identities must sustain genuine two-way traffic per clone across that window, paying bandwidth and latency costs per identity rather than a one-time fee. A sonnet-length audit log per node records retention, making mass spoofing detectable.
